text: Find a company's real published logos by its website domain … Returns the recommended logos and any others found, each a file you can place where the account's logo goes.
Open a page and save its text under fetched/ as evidence. Use it before you put a number or a quote from that page on the page.
Search the web. Set include_domains to the seller's domain to find its own published case studies and customer stories.
Look at up to four images (files from brand/brand.md, images you generated, or images search_assets found), each with its description, before you choose one for a section.
Search the seller's images by what they show and how they look. … Returns the best matches first … Look at one with view_asset before you use it. kind narrows to image or logo.

Make a new image for this site in the brand's style (see the images-and-logos skill). prompt says what it shows; aspect_ratio is the section's shape …; style_references are one to three of the brand's own photos from brand/brand.md.
Look at one of the seller's captured sections on its own: a desktop (1440 wide) and a mobile (375 wide) picture, plus its catalog card
Show a seller's section … and your component … side by side at 1440 and 375 wide, with the share of the area that differs, both heights, and the original's words that yours is missing.
